Task: Filter on Christchurch data only. Use only this filtered dataset from now on.
Using 'june_2026_listings.csv' first

```{r june_2026_listings}

library(tidyverse)
jun_26 <- read_csv('week_5_datasets/june_2026_listings.csv')

print("The first 10 rows are:")
print(head(jun_26, 10))

print("Summary of the dataset is:")
print(summary(jun_26))
```
```{r}
# Check neighbourhood_group column has Christchurch city - list all unique cities in that column
unique(jun_26$neighbourhood_group)
```
```{r}

# Filter out so data only has Christchurch city rows
chch_listings <- jun_26 %>%
  filter(neighbourhood_group == 'Christchurch City')

head(chch_listings)
```

The filtered on Christchurch city data is named: chch_listings
